recipe.prompt:
A professional scientific pipeline flowchart for SciForge Genome-to-BGC Discovery pipeline, styled like a Nature Methods/Nucleic Acids Research workflow figure. Horizontal layout with 7 stages connected by arrows left-to-right: (1) Genome Intake - FASTA/GenBank input with DNA helix icon, (2) antiSMASH BGC Discovery - biosynthetic gene cluster identification with enzyme icon, (3) MIBiG Reference Matching - known cluster dereplication with database icon, (4) BiG-SCAPE Family Clustering - gene cluster family network analysis with network icon, (5) Candidate BGC Card Generation - unified evidence cards with document icon, (6) Multi-Agent Scientific Analysis - mining, dereplication, network analysis, mechanism reasoning with brain/AI icon, (7) Evidence-Grounded Prioritization - scored ranking output with trophy/star icon. Modern clean flat design, gradient blue (#2563EB) to teal (#0D9488) to green (#16A34A) color scheme across stages, rounded rectangular boxes (corner radius 12px) with subtle drop shadows, crisp minimalist outline-style icons for each stage, thin elegant connecting arrows between boxes. White background (#FFFFFF), professional scientific journal quality. No clutter, clear stage numbering (1-7) in circles above each box, readable sans-serif labels (Inter or similar). Wide format suitable for two-column paper figure. The figure should look like it belongs in a top-tier computational biology journal.

SciForge semantic visual brief:
- Treat any upstream scientific_plotting or diagram draft as structure only; create the polished final visual, not a tiny box draft.
- Use a full-canvas composition with clear hierarchy, large readable labels, grouped modules, directional arrows, and visual emphasis on the key scientific/technical relationships.
- Prefer a publication-grade schematic style: clean typography, balanced spacing, subtle color coding, light background, and concise annotations.
- Fill the canvas with meaningful content while preserving the requested scientific semantics; avoid sparse center-only layouts, overlapping labels, illegible microtext, and generic placeholder blocks.
- For model architecture or workflow figures, show inputs, core stages, outputs, side effects/context, and feedback/control loops when relevant.
- Style preset: scientific.
- Output: one self-contained high-resolution PNG-style figure suitable for VisualDocument review.
